summary: Telefonica Brasil filed a Form 6-K announcing the fixed per-share amount for a capital reduction approved at an EGM on March 12, 2026. The total reduction is R$4.0 billion, equating to R$1.25171862845 per share, payable on July 14, 2026 to holders of record as of May 22, 2026. Shares will trade ex-reimbursement rights after May 22. The board determined the payment date. This is a non-routine return of capital to shareholders. No buyback or cancellation of treasury shares occurred. Watch for execution of payment and any shareholder reactions.
